{{Top|canon=Howling Crag}}
The '''Howling Crag Clan''' was a clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witches]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was led by [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mother]] [[Amaya Kymeri]]. Following an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]] of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|blackwing virus]] on Dathomir, a number of members of the clan became infected with the disease and in an attempt to contain the outbreak, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the clan. However three of the infected witches, [[Denkra Kymeri]], [[Naija Kymeri]] and [[Thestriel Kymeri]], survived by using spells to fight off the contagion, and they became known as the [[Sisters of the Void]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Howling Crag Clan was created for the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' and added to the game in December [[2010]], as part of the "Witches of Dathomir Theme Park" quest series.
